title: Lunar M2 isolation: purely gravitational TEP prediction
pre_registered_prediction: The M2 lunar semidiurnal tide (12.4h) is purely gravitational. If the M2-band kernel carries predictive power and beats empirical covariance on independent-year data, that is direct evidence of gravitational coupling with no atmospheric confound.  The M2 band has limited spectral bins, so the test trades purity for power.
